bioghist.head: Biographical Information
bioghist.p: Elizabeth Cureton Rives (1799-1885) was the daughter of Briggs Rives and Anne Cureton Rives. She married Hartwell Peebles Heath (1794-1837) of Petersburg, Virginia, and they had nine children, including Anna Rives Heath (1835-1888). Anna Rives Heath married Daniel William Lassiter (1827-1903) on 8 February 1865. They had five children, including Anna Heath Lassiter (1875-1972). John Langbourne Williams (1831-1915) married Maria Ward Skelton (1843-1929) on 13 October 1865, and they had nine children, including Ennion Gifford Williams (1874-1931). Anna Heath Lassiter married Ennion Gifford Williams 21 October 1902, and they had eight children, including Elizabeth Rives Williams (1916-2018).

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Papers, 1841-2020, of the Rives, Heath, and Lassiter families of Petersburg, Virginia, and the Williams family of Richmond, Virginia, consisting of articles, books, correspondence, diaries, genealogies, photographs, stories, and other papers detailing the lives and genealogies of these families' members.

did.unittitle: Series I: Rives family.

scopecontent.p: Series I: Rives family papers contain genealogies of the Rives, Heath, Lassiter, and Williams families; obituary and epitaph of Francis Everod Rives (1792-1861); photographs of Eliza Cureton Rives Heath (1799-1885); brochure, post cards, and note cards on Castle Hill (Albemarle County, Va.); article on Alfred Rives; and a short stories titled "The Aura" by Elizabeth Rives Fowlkes Williams Miller (1916-2018).

Series II: Heath family.

scopecontent.p: Series II: Heath family papers contain genealogies of the Rives, Heath, Lassiter, and Williams families; correspondence regarding Heath family genealogy; a short titled "The Aura" by Elizabeth Rives Williams Fowlkes Miller; photographs of Eliza Rives Heath (1799-1885), John Francis Heath (1819-1862), Anna Rives Heath (1835-1888), and home of Eliza Rives Heath; book belonging to Anna Rives Heath (1835-1888). Also daguerreotypes and photographs of members of the Heath Family.

scopecontent.p: Series III: Lassiter family papers contain Lassiter-Williams family genealogy; biographical sketches of Daniel William Lassiter (1827-1903); Lassiter family diary pages, 1891-1892; and photographs of Daniel Lassiter, Virginia Heath Lassiter (1874-1902), and Anna Heath Lassiter (1875-1972); memorial volume on Francis Rives Lassiter (1866-1909); information, correspondence, and obituaries for Francis Rives Lassiter, William Lassiter (1866-1959), and Charles Trotter Lassiter (1870-1930); photographs, correspondence, school papers, short stories, poems, and obituary of Anna Heath Lassiter; and photographs of Lassiter home in Petersburg.

scopecontent.p: Series IV: John Langbourne Williams family papers contain Randolph, Skelton, and Williams families genealogies; portraits of the Randolph and Skelton families; obituaries of John Langbourne Williams (1831-1915) and Maria Ward Skelton Williams (1843-1929); publications by and about John Langbourne Williams; information on family reunions; and a volume of family prayers and meditations.

Series V: Ennion Williams family.

scopecontent.p: Series V: Ennion G. Williams family papers contain Williams family genealogies; obituaries of Ennion G. Williams (1874-1931) and Anna Heath Lassiter Williams (1875-1972); diary, letters, papers, and photographs of Ennion G. Williams; articles on Williams' medical career and as Virginia's first Health Commissioner; correspondence and photographs of Anna Lassiter Williams; articles and information on the siblings of Ennion G. Williams; papers and photographs of the children of Ennion and Anna Williams, including Virginia Lassiter Williams (1903-1983) and Elizabeth Rives Williams Fowlkes Miller (1916-2018); photographs and information on "Holly Lawn," the Williams family home; and photographs and papers regarding Williams family reunions. Also includes scrapbooks of Virginia Lassiter Williams and Elizabeth Rives Williams.
